title: Erdos #1162: Subgroups of the Symmetric Group

problemStatement.formal: For f(n) = #{H : H <= S_n}, prove log f(n) = (1/16 + o(1)) n^2 and understand the orders of typical subgroups.
problemStatement.plain: How many subgroups does the symmetric group S_n have, and what can be said about the orders of typical subgroups?
whyMatters: Subgroup enumeration in S_n is a central asymptotic group-theory problem of Erdos and Turan.
The constant 1/16 reflects the dominant role of elementary abelian 2-subgroups.
The Lean file now derives Pyber-style bounds and small cases from a single deep asymptotic axiom.

proven: Lean defines Sn and numSubgroups concretely as the number of subgroups of Equiv.Perm (Fin n).
The Roney-Dougal-Tracey asymptotic is the single active axiom, and Pyber-style two-sided bounds are derived from it.
Small subgroup counts f(1), f(2), f(3), and f(4) are proved, with f2-f4 discharged by native_decide.
open: The Roney-Dougal-Tracey theorem is not proved in Lean.
The statistical theorem on subgroup orders remains only contextual in this file.
The metadata no longer treats the old Docker/build warning as current evidence.

currentState.focus: Metadata now reflects the current one-axiom formalization, proved Pyber consequence, and verified small subgroup counts instead of the stale build-warning copy.
blockers: Typical subgroup-order statistics are not formalized.
currentState.nextAction: Future work can formalize the subgroup-order statistical statement or reduce the asymptotic axiom to a more precise imported theorem interface.
